title: Verify: Asset folders and files unit tests
summary: Unit test that every required folder exists with real files.
description: Write a unit test that checks the folder structure under game/public/assets using the real filesystem read-only.
acceptance_criteria: Given the 9 required folders, when each is read, then each has at least one non-empty file
Given each svg, when read, then it begins with an svg root element

steps.action: Create the test with a FOLDERS array of the 9 relative dirs under game/public/assets (worlds/the-boys-room/backgrounds, furniture, objects, characters, effects, audio and ui/icons, frames, cursors). For each, assert readdirSync returns at least one entry with statSync size > 0. For each .svg found assert the text starts with '<svg'.
steps.code: it.each(FOLDERS)('%s holds a real file', (dir) => { const files = readdirSync(join(root, dir)); expect(files.length).toBeGreaterThan(0); for (const f of files) expect(statSync(join(root, dir, f)).size).toBeGreaterThan(0); });
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/assetFolders.test.ts
steps.expected: All 9 folder cases and the svg-root case pass
